macro.title: SpaceX announces $60 billion Cursor deal to boost AI coding - Yahoo Finance
macro.summary: SpaceX confirmed on Tuesday that it will acquire Anysphere, the company behind the AI coding tool Cursor, for $60 billion.

macro.title: Verizon breaks industry mold | About Verizon - Verizon
macro.summary: Verizon cuts fees, launching "Simplicity" ($45/line) and "Verizon One" ($70 mobile+home bill). Its new loyalty program offers 3% cash back and "Shine" daily rewards for all.
